name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a stronger, more equal partnership between the EU and Africa ahead of a summit in Angola. It asks for joint action on peace and security, trade, investment, migration, climate and support for young people and women. It wants the EU to be more visible in Africa, to ratify the Samoa Agreement, and to set up regular meetings between African and European politicians. This is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament sets out its demands for the summit.
- **Who it affects:** EU and African governments, businesses, students and migrants.
- **What happens next:** Leaders meet in Luanda and may adopt a joint plan for 2025–2030.
